description: This PHP script sets up the edit view for a scheduler module in SuiteCRM, including access control, loading scheduler data, preparing form fields, JavaScript validation, and rendering the HTML template for editing scheduled tasks.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: Class responsible for managing JavaScript validation and client-side scripting for the scheduler edit view.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: Template rendering class used to generate the HTML markup for the scheduler edit form.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean object with the JavaScript validator for form validation.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the name of the form to be validated.

methods.name: addAllFields
methods.description: Adds all fields of the form to JavaScript validation.

methods.name: addFieldGeneric
methods.description: Adds a generic field for validation with specified parameters.

methods.name: addToValidateBinaryDependency
methods.description: Adds validation rules for binary dependencies between two form fields.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Retrieves the generated JavaScript code for client-side validation.
